title: Trinity’s new beginning
summary: Trinity makes Impact the setting for a new championship chapter. She defeats Deonna Purrazzo before facing Jordynne Grace as the company returns to the TNA name.

chapters.title: Trinity wins the Knockouts championship
chapters.result: Trinity defeats Deonna Purrazzo for the title.
chapters.context: Her arrival becomes a championship success, giving the division a new central figure and a fresh set of challengers.

chapters.title: Grace wins at TNA’s return
chapters.result: Jordynne Grace defeats Trinity to win the championship.
chapters.context: The first pay-per-view under the restored TNA name closes Trinity’s reign and begins another Grace title chapter.
